## Design

### 2026-11-08: I finished one half of the schematic. The things that took me a lot of time was that there were just so many components to wire, and the pins placement were a bit off for some of the components, so I

**3h**

I finished one half of the schematic. The things that took me a lot of time was that there were just so many components to wire, and the pins placement were a bit off for some of the components, so I had to look elsewhere for them. There were also a lot of power symbols and components I had never used before. Now, I will start on the second half of the schematic.

### 2026-11-08: I started by doing the layout of the PCB, with me having to meticulously put each component to mirror the Schematic. I feel that this process is what took me so much time, but it was overall worth it.

**4h**

I started by doing the layout of the PCB, with me having to meticulously put each component to mirror the Schematic. I feel that this process is what took me so much time, but it was overall worth it. Now, I will start by wiring the PCB together.
